decisions.reason: Gives installation, finishing, and protection requirements for interior window sills without ordering their supply.
Sets general selection, thickness, and installation requirements for door frames without ordering a specific frame.
Specifies permissible door clearances, trimming, and threshold heights; it does not order a new product.
Sets general requirements for tested fire door assemblies, documentation, and acceptance without ordering a specific assembly.
Specifies concealed wiring and strike plates as provisions within door assemblies; it does not order a separate product or the future electric strikes.
Defines which hardware is required on escape-route doors under different conditions without ordering a distinct hardware product.
Sets door closer selection, mounting, and adjustment requirements without ordering a specific closer.
Explicitly assigns supply and installation of the door hold-open system and its components to the contractor.

items.material_name: Fire and smoke door hold-open system with slide-rail closer, smoke detection control unit, and ceiling smoke detectors
items.description: Includes a manual release button and fire alarm interface; wall-mounted magnets are specified for heavy-use areas.
